name: BambooHR
description: Monitor employee records, onboarding/offboarding status, and HR compliance in BambooHR

config.setupInstructions:
1. Log in to BambooHR
2. Click your profile icon (top right) > API Keys > Add New Key
3. Copy the API key
4. Enter your BambooHR subdomain and the API key below

credentialFields.label: API Key
credentialFields.helpText: Found in BambooHR > profile icon > API Keys > Add New Key
